name: writey
description: Writey — text to handwriting converter (India-facing MVP preview)

scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply writey-preview --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.dev:worker:production: npm run build:production && wrangler d1 migrations apply writey --local --env production --persist-to .wrangler/state-production && wrangler dev --env production --local --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/state-production
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && VITE_ENABLE_QA=1 vite build && VITE_ENABLE_QA=1 node --experimental-strip-types scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:production: SITE_URL=https://text2handwriting.site VITE_SITE_URL=https://text2handwriting.site tsc --noEmit && SITE_URL=https://text2handwriting.site VITE_SITE_URL=https://text2handwriting.site vite build && SITE_URL=https://text2handwriting.site VITE_SITE_URL=https://text2handwriting.site node --experimental-strip-types scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply writey --local --env production --persist-to .wrangler/state-production
